map.感抗 XL = 2π × f × L，其中 L 以亨利计（1 μH = 10⁻⁶: Inductive reactance XL = 2π × f × L, with L in henries (1 μH = 10⁻⁶ H). For example a 100 μH inductor gives XL ≈ 0.628 Ω at 1 kHz and ≈ 6.28 Ω at 10 kHz, proportional to frequency. Inductive and capacitive reactance have opposite directions (XC = 1 ÷ (2πfC)), and in series resonance XL equals XC at f₀ = 1 ÷ (2π√(LC)).
